description:
## Summary
Port the `/resume` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher. The existing `/sessions` command may be a partial attempt at this; its relationship should be resolved.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/resume` opens a full `SessionSelectorComponent` overlay for browsing and resuming a previous session.

UI elements visible in the overlay:
```
─────────────────────────────────────
  Sessions

  [search input]
  
  > session-name-1   12 msgs  2h ago     ← selected (accent color, → prefix)
    session-name-2    5 msgs  1d ago
    session-name-3   31 msgs  3d ago
  (1/47)
─────────────────────────────────────
  scope: local  sort: modified  [ctrl+n: named only]
```

Keyboard actions (with on-screen cues):
- **↑/↓**: move selection; entry highlight follows cursor
- **Enter**: load and resume the selected session
- **Tab**: toggle scope (local ↔ global); label updates in status line
- **Ctrl+S**: cycle sort order (modified / created / name); label updates
- **Ctrl+N**: toggle named-only filter; `[ctrl+n: named only]` hint in status
- **Ctrl+D**: delete selected session (shows confirmation prompt before deleting)
- **Ctrl+P**: toggle showing full file path vs. session name in the list
- **Type**: filters list by session name (fuzzy search)
- **Escape**: dismiss without changing session

Count badge: `(selectedIndex+1 / totalFiltered)` left-aligned in muted color.

## Source References
- Component: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/session-selector.ts`
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 4293 `showSessionSelector()`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"resume"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"resume"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/resume` dispatch clause
3. Port `SessionSelectorComponent`: search input, scope/sort/filter controls, delete-with-confirm, full path toggle, fuzzy list with count badge
4. On Enter: load selected session file and update all app state accordingly
5. Resolve relationship with existing `/sessions` command — upstream has no `/sessions`; `/session` (singular) shows current session info; `/resume` is the session picker
title: Port /resume command
